'''General Salipada K. Pendatun''', officially the '''Municipality of General Salipada K. Pendatun''' ([[Maguindanao language|Maguindanaon]]: ''Inged nu General Salipada K. Pendatun''; [[Iranun language|Iranun]]: ''Inged a General Salipada K. Pendatun''; {{langx|tl|Bayan ng Heneral Salipada K. Pendatun}}), is a [[municipality of the Philippines|municipality]] in the [[Philippine Province|province]] of [[Maguindanao del Sur]], [[Philippines]]. According to the {{PH wikidata|population_as_of}}, it has a population of {{PH wikidata|population_total}} people.{{PH wikidata|population_reference}} It is named after General [[Salipada K. Pendatun]] (1912 – 1985), who was a forerunner Mindanaoan Legislator and General during the Second World War. ==History== On April 7, 1991, ''Muslim Mindanao Autonomy Act No. 3'' created the Municipality of General S. K. Pendatun out of the municipality of [[Buluan]],{{cite web|title=Regional Act No. 3; An Act Creating the Municipality of General Salipada K. Pendatun in the Province of Maguindanao, Appropriating Funds Therefor, and for Other Purposes|url=http://rla-armmgov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/MMAA-3.pdf|website=Regional Legislative Assembly, Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao|accessdate=January 27, 2016}}{{cite web|url= https://www.census.gov.ph/census2000/p153800.html|title= Census 2000 Final Counts|accessdate= May 20, 2008|author= Philippine Statistics Authority|date= April 23, 2001|url-status= dead|archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20071126052939/http://www.census.gov.ph//census2000/p153800.html|archivedate= November 26, 2007}} making it the first [[local government]] unit created by the [[Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao#Legislative|ARMM Regional Assembly]].{{cite web|url=http://iag.org.ph/cgi-bin/policiesandlaws/files/REGIONAL%20LAWS.pdf |title=List of MMA Acts |accessdate=May 20, 2008 |author=Institute for Autonomy and Governance |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20111009035856/http://iag.org.ph/cgi-bin/policiesandlaws/files/REGIONAL%20LAWS.pdf |archivedate=October 9, 2011 }} The municipality of [[Paglat]] was created out of four of its barangays on September 29, 2001.{{cite web|url=https://www.census.gov.ph/data/sectordata/2007/armm.pdf |title=2007 Census of Population: Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao |accessdate=May 19, 2008 |author=Philippine Statistics Authority |date=April 16, 2008 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080905134026/http://www.census.gov.ph/data/sectordata/2007/armm.pdf |archivedate=September 5, 2008 }} ==Geography== ===Barangays=== General Salipada K. Pendatun is politically subdivided into 19 [[barangay]]s.{{cite web|url= http://www.nscb.gov.ph/activestats/psgc/municipality.asp?muncode=153819000®code=15&provcode=38|title= PSGC Interactive: Municipality/City: GEN.
